items.proposal: Adopt one DispatchHost-owned S1 DocumentSession per trusted document, immutable candidates/ephemeral views; no WORK new owner model or identity allocation.
Adopt raw design_json before C1 typed conversion, canonical profile/semantic exclusions and one S1 Edit commit; no implicit filtering/stamping/Form insertion.
Adopt inert read-only placeholders and disabled edits/mocks/save for unsupported nodes or absent Form, no silent conversion.
Adopt13 closed commands, structured exact error fields, decimal u64 revisions and proposed limits/ordering.
Adopt six supported node mock types/actions, detached map, exact payload, strict sequence and revocation; no dispatch/IO/AI/Git.
Adopt explicit viewer capability split, role-specific actual sender guard, one writer transfer and native close/reload/root-switch revocation.
Adopt18 exact paths, application owner module/test paths and three legacy typed commands fail-closed, explicit old assertion migration; no dependency/lock changes.
Adopt C1 dependency and M04_S2 DependencyNotReady boundary; H2 preview/owner is not full save/open release completion. Build Skeleton/valid RED only after this approval.

decisions.preserves: C1 CP1-CP3 remains separately pending; do not treat H2 adoption as implicit C1 contract adoption; existing S1/IO accepted behavior unchanged.

records.DesignOwnerRecord: private DispatchHost-owned binding_ref UUID, trusted project UUID + document UUID from existing manifest/WORK adoption, canonical reference, one S1 DocumentSession, writer window-instance nonce, checked u64 owner_generation, projection epoch
records.CandidateRecord: private request UUID, binding/session/generation/captured revision, immutable validated DesignDoc/canonical payload/semantic digest, unsupported list, source kind; never independently mutable SSOT
records.PreviewSession: private UUID, binding/session/generation/revision, consumer window nonce, expected_seq u64 initially1, immutable source snapshot, detached mock values, capabilities, active/stale state

owner_binding.identity: Reuse existing trusted bound project and explicitly adopted manifest document identity. No implicit WORK registration or new persistent UUID on load; absent/conflicting manifest binding -> MissingBinding/IdentityConflict and read-only diagnostic, no write. H2 does not change manifest schema or document adoption APIs.
owner_binding.owner_init: Explicit design_binding_open consumes validated project/document reference already resolved server-side; first owner creates S1 DocumentSession only after C1 candidate validation. Two requests same bound project/document return same owner projection; never create a second session for another view. Initialization status Editing,revision0,formal/snapshot baseline None until approved M04 opener supplies trusted baselines; dirty=true when no formal baseline. Do not fabricate disk-saved baseline from parse-only success.
owner_binding.S1_reuse: S1 content/history/revision/baselines remain sole authoritative content state. HOST/Tauri owns one DocumentSession instance per bound document; UI designDoc becomes render projection, never writable authority. No change to DocumentSession API or constructors outside new owner initializer. Domain has no Tauri/serde/filesystem dependency.
owner_binding.semantic_profile: Canonical payload is C1 validated compact JSON with all object keys recursively sorted by UTF8 bytes, array order retained, supported number values C1-canonicalized; preserve loaded selection/updatedAt/product_pass=false compatibility values in payload but exclude /selection,/meta/updatedAt,/product_pass from semantic fingerprint projection. Hash fingerprint bytes sha256. These values are not edited by selection/time/view events. Any profile change requires replanning; raw file hash is separate M04 concern.
owner_binding.mutation: All property/layout/create/delete/guide/grid/Form changes submit closed full-candidate design_json + expected revision. Validate structure, supported node types, unique stable IDs and all parent refs; no implicit remapping or label lookup. Use existing S1 prepare(Edit, validated_after) then commit once; no mutation if candidate semantic content identical (return current projection without commit). Clear uses existing Clear; undo uses existing S1 undo; redo deferred because no public S1 redo API. Never mutate UI then declare host success retroactively.
owner_binding.unsupported: Read-only preserved projection, inert placeholders, unsupported ID/type list. No source-node filtering/stamping/Form insertion. Editing, save, and Viewer mock entry disabled while unsupported types/missing root Form exist. User must use a future explicit supported conversion workflow; no silent repair. Unknown scope labels remain data and grant no capabilities.
owner_binding.writer: Exactly one current writer: main or ui-editor instance. Viewer never writer. Current writer explicitly grants to an existing trusted ui-editor/main window nonce using design_binding_transfer; transfer increments generation, revokes candidates/preview sessions, preserves S1 content/history/revision. Transfer to missing/remote/viewer denied. Window destruction retires writer; replacement writer requires authenticated main claim with explicit confirmation, not matching label alone.
owner_binding.projection: All views receive raw validated canonical design_json plus revision/generation/dirty/can_edit/unsupported metadata. UI JSON.parse only after HOST C1 validation. A stale response cannot replace newer projection; rendering failure leaves old display with stale badge and authority remains HOST.
owner_binding.persistence: No new H2 filesystem-save path. design_document_save returns DependencyNotReady(M04_S2) until an approved M04 persistence input seam is wired in a separately reviewed integration slice. Legacy uidesign_save_design/load_design/build_preview handlers fail closed with DESIGN_OWNER_REQUIRED for authoritative owner operations; no typed/raw root bypass. Existing exported communication preview remains explicitly non-authoritative; it is not upgraded to trusted Viewer IPC in this slice.
owner_binding.boundaries: Session/runtime teardown loses unsaved state only after explicit discard confirmation; this H2 proposal adds no autosave/recovery store. M04/M07 integration readiness remains separate; owner emits completed mutation observations only, never claims snapshot persistence.
owner_binding.request_records: All commands carrying request_id use runtime key(binding_ref,session_uuid,operation,request_id) with immutable typed capture. Validate caller first, then same-ID identical capture returns retained original terminal result with replayed=true and no extra commit/undo/save; different capture RequestConflict. Matching in-flight request Busy. Capture revision checked for new requests, never use a repeated request to mutate newer revision. New request_id with used candidate -> CandidateUsed. Retain until owner closed, at128 keys per binding/1024 runtime refuse before reservation, no eviction/time-based retry. No durable exactly-once across restart. Close/revoke removes replay authority; late response never installs over newer projection.
owner_binding.open_dependency: design_binding_open must use an approved M04 owner-open input dependency to obtain identity-bound validated snapshot/baselines. Until that dependency exists return DependencyNotReady(M04_OWNER_INTEGRATION), no direct legacy load or invented initial content. Test doubles supply immutable approved-shaped snapshots in RED/component tests; they are not native integration proof.

responses.common: {ok:true,value:<result>,replayed:bool} | {ok:false,error:{code:<listed>,details:<exact closed fields>},replayed:bool}; no simultaneous value/error. Only identical retained authorized request_id replay sets replayed=true; UI never replaces newer revision/generation from a replayed old result.

responses.Candidate: {candidate_ref UUID, request_id UUID, captured_revision u64 string, unsupported:[...], installable bool}; no auto install
responses.InstallUndoTransfer: BindingProjection; changed bool and history_depth u64 string on actual content mutation only
responses.Preview: {preview_session UUID,source_revision u64 string,expected_sequence u64 string,stale bool,mock_state:{node_id:typed value},capabilities:[node_id,allowed_action list]}; no native root or writer token

validation_order: retained request lookup: identical authorized replay returns, changed capture conflicts
C1 raw design guards and graph/type checks
reserve request then authoritative commit or detached mock update
dto.raw_ingress: design_json must be an inner JSON string parsed only by C1 before any Value/DesignDoc conversion. At command admission cap32MiB on the serialized decoded outer envelope, plus16MiB inner text. This does not prevent allocation in Tauri transport before command admission; no raw outer duplicate-key guarantee is claimed. Inner design_json duplicate guard remains exact. Do not count nested text as outer JSON depth. No arbitrary root/digest/approval fields.

viewer.mode_entry: Explicit begin from current immutable owner revision; read-only supported design only. Detached mock map seeded from declared safe props or neutral values; no content write. Consumer is bound to actual window instance/preview UUID.
viewer.supported_schema: H2 supports Form/Button/CheckBox/TextBox/NumberInput/ComboBox only for mock capability. Button props permitted activation only. ComboBox items must be array of closed {id:string,label:string}, unique nonempty IDs; absent/unsupported items -> UnsupportedAction, not labels-as-identity. Scope must be absent or ui; unknown/non-ui scope disables mock capabilities without changing source. uiExclusive is data, never grants authority.

matrix.effect: set detached text, render via textContent
C1 exact numeric guard, set detached canonical numeric value; never JS float proof
only declared stable item ID from immutable supported items schema

viewer.sequence: Start expected_seq=1, increment checked once only on accepted mock action. Reject wrong/stale/invalid payload without consuming sequence. u64 max cannot be incremented -> SequenceOverflow and close preview, no partial update. Accepted action replay with old seq -> SequenceConflict; no second effect.
viewer.payload_rules: Action determines exact oneOf payload variant: Activate {},SetToggle checked,SetText text,SetNumber number_text,SelectItem item_id. Reject extra fields, mismatch, arbitrary command/eval/url/file/target paths.
viewer.permissions: Viewer capability allows only binding_get, viewer_begin/intent/refresh/close; never candidate/edit/undo/save/transfer or general dispatch/host-default. Viewer mock actions cannot call Tauri invoke by action string.
viewer.refresh: Build temporary supported projection from current owner snapshot after explicit refresh request. Revalidate generation/revision/consumer, replace only on success, new preview UUID and sequence1; retire old preview. Failure leaves previous mock projection visibly stale, cannot act until valid refresh.
viewer.revocation: Content revision, writer generation, project/document close, navigation/reload/destroy revokes affected preview; mock values discarded. No late response installs against different owner.
viewer.materials: No file/network/image loading as mock effect. If immutable content references unresolved material/binding, show inert placeholder and disable dependent action with MissingMaterial/MissingBindingTarget. No fake media substitute or execution.

permissions.main: default capability adds design owner read/write and viewer group; actual handler still checks caller/binding/role. Existing main generic privileges unchanged outside this task.
permissions.editor: uidesign-window.json windows becomes [ui-editor]; retain old unrelated privilege sets only as historical editor capability, add design groups; every old design mutation entry now DESIGN_OWNER_REQUIRED. No generic action dispatch from runtime.
permissions.viewer: New capabilities/design-viewer.json windows=[ui-viewer], only core window chrome + design-viewer-mock. Remove ui-viewer from prior broad uidesign-window group; no host-default/dispatch-default/core webview-create. app bootstrap for viewer must use binding projection only, not privileged main initialization.
permissions.native_guard: Injected WebviewWindow with trusted instance nonce; allow local tauri://localhost or http(s)://tauri.localhost without explicit port, role-specific labels main/ui-editor/ui-viewer. Remote/dev origins reject. Do not reuse main-only guard by silently weakening its existing policy for other commands; add a dedicated design caller policy.
permissions.legacy: uidesign_save_design/load_design/build_preview kept registered for source/ACL compatibility but return DESIGN_OWNER_REQUIRED for old authoritative args; no typed doc path reaches filesystem. Exported communication preview generation is deferred compatibility artifact path, not a backdoor to Viewer privileges. uidesign_ask_agent does not become a Viewer action.
permissions.host_allowlist: Add exactly listed13 commands to AllowedIpcCommand parse/enum; no wildcard. Main/editor role authority is native application gate beyond allowlist.
permissions.test_migration: commands.rs existing guard_owner_caller_tests assertion windows=[ui-editor,ui-viewer] changes explicitly to editor-only plus separate viewer capability assertions; preserve all original main-only guard denial tests. Archive old test snippet/hash in implementation-stage evidence before changing assertion.

architecture.hexagonal: UI main/editor/viewer driving adapters -> strict role Tauri input ports -> DispatchHost application DesignOwner -> existing WORK DocumentSession + HOST C1 codec -> projections
architecture.dependency: DesignOwner depends on S1 pure APIs and C1 public boundary; Viewer mock state depends only immutable snapshot. No new domain infrastructure/Port/file persistence. M04 persistence remains an explicit unavailable input dependency.
architecture.state_owner: Exactly one S1 DocumentSession owns content/history/baselines per manifest document; application binding and preview/candidate records are derived. UI owns only ephemeral render/mock local mirrors.
architecture.transaction: prepare raw candidate -> guarded validation -> revision/generation recheck -> one S1 commit -> projection notification; failed render does not undo content, failed candidate never installs
architecture.forbidden: no JS FS/adapter/owner bypass; no domain Tauri/serde; no private IO journal; no second WORK identity registry; no generic Viewer dispatch
